name: Nanometer Lighting (nanoltg)
old_description: Architectural micro-linear LED fixtures, backlighting, tunable-white/RGBW systems
about:
Nanometer Lighting operates from New York, New York, as a subsidiary of Aither Global Holdings. The company describes itself as an architectural illumination firm focused on expanding the possibilities of LED lighting through both technological and aesthetic innovation.

The firm develops and manufactures modular LED fixtures, microlinear lighting, control systems, and backlighting solutions. Its product range includes tunable-white, RGB, and RGBW LEDs paired with dimming and pixel-controlled technologies. The company also provides bespoke installation services, covering projects from conceptualization through to final installation.

Nanometer serves the architectural, commercial, and residential lighting sectors, positioning itself as a partner for iconic brands across the United States. Its solutions are specified for feature walls, seamless linear runs, and health-focused lighting environments.

The company emphasizes a holistic view of lighting, breaking it down to basic forms to address wellness, sustainability, and creative needs. It differentiates itself by offering a complete, frictionless approach that integrates design, manufacturing, and installation under one roof.
